content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (OSU runup benchmark, BM2) plotting model vs measured surface elevation at 9 wave gauges in stacked custom-position subplots. fact=1 (unused), sk=8 subsampling (L4-5); figure 6x7 in (L7). Loads model FSE_BM2_shi_tvd.txt (L9; t column 1 L13, eta columns 2:n L14) and aligns time by peak match with WG1.txt (L16-34; t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift L34, no extra offset). Collects measured gauges WG1..WG9 column 2 into WG(:,1..9) (L37-53; WGdata ends holding WG9.txt). Layout parameters xwidth=0.85, yheight=0.08, ymargin=0.0225, x1=0.1, obs_line_width=2, obs_color='k', BO_style='--', BO_line_width=1.0 (L55-63). Loop i=1:9 (L66-93): subplot at Position [x1 0.885-(i-1)*(yheight+ymargin) xwidth yheight] (L68); plots measured WG(:,i)/100 (cm to m) against WGdata time column subsampled by sk (L70), solid black (L72); model eta(:,i) dashed (L74-75); ylabel eta (L77), axis [0 47 -0.2 0.5] (L78); legend on first panel (L80-82); 'Gauge i' text (L84); x tick labels suppressed except bottom panel (L86-90). xlabel (L95); script-level break (L97); commented print to WG1_comp.eps (L103).
entities: script variables: fact @L4, sk @L5, data @L9, m,n @L12, t @L13, eta @L14, WGdata @L16 (reassigned L38-52, final=WG9.txt), num_shift_ind @L20, num_t_shift @L21, exp_shift_ind @L28, exp_t_shift @L29, WG @L37-53, xwidth @L55, yheight @L57, ymargin @L58, x1 @L59, obs_line_width @L60, obs_color @L61, BO_style @L62, BO_line_width @L63, i @L66, h1 @L70, h2 @L74

equations.ref: measured eta cm to m, subsampled; time column from WGdata (=WG9.txt)

calls: clf @L1; clear all @L2; set(gcf,...) @L7; load @L9, @L16, @L38, @L40, @L42, @L44, @L46, @L48, @L50, @L52; size @L12; max @L19, @L27; subplot @L68; plot @L70, @L74; set(h1/h2/gca) @L72, @L75, @L89; hold on @L73; ylabel @L77; axis @L78; legend @L81; text @L84; num2str @L84; grid @L92; xlabel @L95; break @L97
unresolved: All measured gauges are plotted against the time column of WGdata, which after L37-52 holds WG9.txt (L70) -- gauges 1-8 use gauge 9's clock and its record length; assumes identical time bases across WG*.txt, not verifiable here.

WG(:,i) columns are filled assuming every WG*.txt has the same number of rows (L37-53); measured values divided by 100 (cm to m, L70) whereas the ADV scripts multiply model by 100 -- unit conventions differ per file type.
Script-level break at L97 outside any loop is an error in modern MATLAB (legacy versions treated it as no-op); everything after it is blank/comment anyway.
fact (L4) and BO_line_width (L63) are defined but unused (the LineWidth set call is commented at L76); MarkerSize is set with obs_line_width (L72) though the line has no markers.
Unlike the ADV scripts there is no -0.25 s correction (L34); model eta columns 2..10 are paired with gauges 1..9 implicitly.
